howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Take a clear photo of the waste issue or upload from your device.
howItWorks.step2Desc: GPS automatically detects location; refine location on map if needed.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Select category and write a short description — more details help quick resolution.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Submit your report and receive a unique Report ID for live tracking.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Do I need an account to submit a report?
faq.a1: No, citizens can submit waste reports directly without registering or logging in. Just upload a photo, select location, and submit.
faq.q2: What happens after I submit a report?
faq.a2: The DNCC administration team verifies the report and assigns it to local field cleaning workers for immediate cleanup action.
faq.q3: Can I track the progress of my report?
faq.a3: Yes, you can track real-time progress using your unique Report ID (e.g. FIX-2026-000123) or mobile number on the tracking page.
